description: Context-sensitive property inspector for the currently selected section, column, or block. The header names the element and offers Duplicate/Delete as one-step undo actions; the body splits into an Obsah/Styl tab strip with the Spacing and Advanced fields in collapsible groups, and renders the element's common fields plus type-specific editors such as rich-text content, raw HTML, image upload, and variable insertion.

parameters.name: ImageUpload
parameters.description: Client-side limits applied to a picked image before OnImageUpload runs; null uses the ImageUploadOptions defaults (5 MB, images only).

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised with the selected block id when the header's Delete action is used (rendered as a danger action). Without a handler the action is not rendered.

parameters.name: OnDuplicate
parameters.description: Raised with the selected block id when the header's Duplicate action is used. The editor implements it as one history step; without a handler the action is not rendered.

parameters.name: OnImageUpload
parameters.description: Optional host upload handler: receives a picked file and returns the hosted image URL.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the inspector read-only: every control inside the panel is disabled natively and the upload affordance is hidden, so no property change can reach the document.

parameters.name: SelectedId
parameters.description: The selected node id (block, section or column); null edits the document settings.

parameters.name: Variables
parameters.description: Host-provided variables, merged with those extracted from the document.
